description: This file provides a client setup for interacting with a Supabase backend, including configuration checks, version detection, and utility functions for accessing tables within the 'app' schema.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the Supabase client is properly configured with URL and key.

methods.name: fromApp
methods.description: Returns a query builder for a specified table within the 'app' schema, maintaining compatibility for future non-public tables.

methods.name: getSupabaseVersion
methods.description: Returns the detected version string of the supabase-js library.
